hebrewText: וַ/אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי נִגְרַ֖שְׁתִּי מִ/נֶּ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ אַ֚ךְ אוֹסִ֣יף לְ/הַבִּ֔יט אֶל הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁ/ךָ

tokens.kjv: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.kjv: cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, [idiom] surely put away, trouble, thrust out.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.enLiteralWord: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.explanation: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.explanationEn: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce

tokens.bdb: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
tokens.kjv: about, (over) against, [idiom] aloof, [idiom] far (off), [idiom] from, over, presence, [idiom] other side, sight, [idiom] to view.

tokens.bdb: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).

tokens.bdb: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
tokens.kjv: also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily, [phrase] wherefore, yet (but).

tokens.bdb: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
tokens.kjv: add, [idiom] again, [idiom] any more, [idiom] cease, [idiom] come more, [phrase] conceive again, continue, exceed, [idiom] further, [idiom] gather together, get more, give more-over, [idiom] henceforth, increase (more and more), join, [idiom] longer (bring, do, make, much, put), [idiom] (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, [idiom] yet, yield.

tokens.bdb: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
tokens.kjv: (cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
